# Operator Health Check — 2026-03-13 12:51 UTC

## Summary
Health check completed. Host resources are within limits, but there are service-level issues that need follow-up.

## PM2
- Online: agent-log, gpu-router, iam-chat-proxy, kira-admin, kira-app, kira-dashboard, oopuo-website, openclaw-bridge, openclaw-gateway, stella-tax, whatsapp-bridge, zenithcred-website
- Stopped: whisper
- Notable: openclaw-gateway in PM2 shows online but restarted 8987 times and had 0s uptime at check time

## Docker
- Healthy/Up: client-ops-postgres, iam-mysql, lidaros-backend-1, inventree-db, inventree-redis, langfuse_postgres_1, langfuse_redis_1, langfuse_minio_1, omiximo-bridge
- Up: iam-staging-nginx, iam-web-3007, scribe-service, nextjs-server, neo4j-server, iam-ghost, kali-osint, inventree-frontend, inventree-server, inventree-worker, evolution_api, evolution_postgres, ollama, n8n
- Unhealthy: lidaros-frontend-1, omiximo-email-automation
- Restarting: langfuse_langfuse-web_1

## Disk
- Root filesystem /dev/sda1: 454G used / 208G available / 69% used
- No disk alert threshold breached

## Memory
- RAM: 11.4G used / 27.5G total
- Available: 16.1G
- Swap: 0 configured
- No RAM alert threshold breached

## GPU
- RTX 4090 present
- GPU memory: 20550 MiB / 24564 MiB in use
- GPU util: 0%
- Main process: VLLM::EngineCore using ~20540 MiB
- GPU is heavily allocated but not overloaded at check time

## OpenClaw Gateway
- openclaw gateway status reports runtime: stopped (state inactive, sub dead, last exit 203, reason 1)
- RPC probe: ok
- Listening detected on 127.0.0.1:18789
- Service config warning: installed systemd unit is out of date/non-standard and embeds OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN; suggested remediation is reinstalling service
- Additional doctor warnings: Telegram and WhatsApp groupPolicy set to allowlist with no allowFrom/groupAllowFrom entries, so group messages will be silently dropped

## Assessment
Host capacity is fine. Immediate concerns are service reliability and config hygiene, not resource exhaustion.

## Follow-up
1. Investigate why OpenClaw systemd gateway shows inactive while RPC probe still succeeds and PM2 openclaw-gateway is active
2. Confirm whether whisper being stopped is intentional
3. Repair langfuse_langfuse-web_1 restart loop
4. Repair lidaros-frontend-1 and omiximo-email-automation unhealthy states
5. Review Telegram/WhatsApp allowlist config if group delivery is expected
